# Agent License

> Signed agent licenses that say which agent is calling, who it acts for, and what it may do. Checked at a checkpoint outside the agent.

Agent License is a prototype of agent identity and delegated authority. An issuer signs a license. The agent presents that license and a per-call justification. A checkpoint checks the signature, the mandate, the delegation chain, and a Cedar policy, then appends the decision to a Merkle log. The CLI is `agentlicense`. The SDK entry point is `licensed(fetch)` from `@agentlicense/sdk`.

This repository is a prototype. Services bind to localhost. The npm packages are not published yet.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/quickstart/): Install Agent License, create keys, and issue a signed agent credential you can inspect and check.
- [Concepts](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/concepts/): Agent identity, the three mandates, delegation, checkpoints, Cedar policy, and the Merkle decision log.
- [CLI reference](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/cli/): Every agentlicense command and flag, generated from agentlicense --help.
- [SDK reference](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/sdk/): Call a checkpoint with licensed(fetch), and use the core API to issue, verify, attenuate, and explain an agent credential.
- [Running a checkpoint](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/checkpoint/): Start the local issuer, checkpoint, Cedar PDP, and Merkle log, then verify a decision.
- [FAQ](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/docs/faq/): Which agent is calling, how a license differs from a guess, and what this prototype does not do.

## Optional

- [License format](https://github.com/mlescaille/agent-town/blob/main/spec/LICENSE-FORMAT.md): Byte-level rules for the license, justification, and log
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/mlescaille/agent-town/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): MCP gateway and the limits of this prototype
- [Repository](https://github.com/mlescaille/agent-town): Source, issues, and the `agentlicense` CLI
- [Proposed descriptor](https://mlescaille.github.io/agent-town/.well-known/agent-license.json): Not an IANA registration. The running PDP's AuthZEN discovery document is separate
